profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Currently working as a software developer on enterprise tools, internal tools, and audio visual hardware control systems. I attended St. Marys University for a Masters in Software engineering and prior to that graduated from Full Sail university with a Bachelors in Recording Arts. With the end of my Masters degree program, my focus in creating software is that it is developed to what the user needs, whether that be performance, interaction and usability, cost or versitility. I primarily develop in Visual Studio and VSCode, due to the languages, API, SDK, and so on, that can be accessed within. I work with the windows Console/Terminal and powerfully daily. While working on projects throughout the Software Engineering Program and working in Engineering Support I've recognized the necessity of well thought through Design and strive in my designs, implementation and analysis to reflect that. From assembling project proposal information, designs of collaborative systems, stategies and plans on implementation of design, I apply forethought to achieve an outcome with value.
